ARGUMENTS_INVALID.title: Tool arguments failed validation
ARGUMENTS_INVALID.next_action: Compare the request with the signed tool input schema.

CRITICAL_DETERMINISTIC_FINDING.title: A critical deterministic finding is present
CRITICAL_DETERMINISTIC_FINDING.next_action: Resolve or review the specific blocking finding.

EFFECT_NOT_AUTHORIZED.title: One or more tool effects are unauthorized
EFFECT_NOT_AUTHORIZED.next_action: Review the detailed capability and resource checks below.

EFFECT_SET_MISMATCH.title: Observed effect set differs from the signed contract
EFFECT_SET_MISMATCH.next_action: Compare the requested effects with the approved contract.

IDENTITY_NOT_VERIFIED.title: Agent identity was not verified
IDENTITY_NOT_VERIFIED.next_action: Check the trusted agent identity and session.

NORMALIZED_REQUEST_INVALID.title: Normalized operation facts were not verified
NORMALIZED_REQUEST_INVALID.next_action: Inspect the normalization and evidence for this tool call.

REVIEW_NOT_APPROVED.title: Security review has not approved this tool
REVIEW_NOT_APPROVED.next_action: Complete the review of the current tool fingerprint.

SENSITIVE_RESOURCE.title: A sensitive resource reference is forbidden
SENSITIVE_RESOURCE.next_action: Review the requested resource and the sensitive-resource policy.

SERVER_NOT_TRUSTED.title: MCP server trust is missing or blocked
SERVER_NOT_TRUSTED.next_action: Review and approve the current server trust record.

SESSION_NOT_ACTIVE.title: Agent session is not active
SESSION_NOT_ACTIVE.next_action: Authenticate again with an active session.

SIGNED_CONTRACT_BINDING_INVALID.title: Signed tool contract does not match the active configuration
SIGNED_CONTRACT_BINDING_INVALID.next_action: Check the active signed revision and contract binding.

SUBJECT_AUTHORIZATION_NOT_RESOLVED.title: Agent authorization could not be resolved
SUBJECT_AUTHORIZATION_NOT_RESOLVED.next_action: Review the agent's published capability grants.

TOOL_ANALYSIS_NOT_APPROVED.title: Tool analysis is not approved
TOOL_ANALYSIS_NOT_APPROVED.next_action: Review and approve the exact tool observation.

TOOL_APPROVAL_BINDING_INVALID.title: Tool approval does not match this observation or revision
TOOL_APPROVAL_BINDING_INVALID.next_action: Recheck the observation approval against the current tool.

CAPABILITY_NOT_ACTIVE_OR_UNKNOWN.title: Capability is unknown or inactive in the catalog

CAPABILITY_NOT_GRANTED.title: Agent lacks the required capability
CAPABILITY_NOT_GRANTED.next_action: Review the required agent capability grant; do not broaden permissions without approval.

EFFECT_FACT_MISSING_OR_INCONSISTENT.title: Effect facts are missing or inconsistent

RESOURCE_BINDING_OR_SCOPE_UNAUTHORIZED.title: Resource binding or scope was not authorized
RESOURCE_BINDING_OR_SCOPE_UNAUTHORIZED.next_action: Verify the canonical resource, scope and authority.

RESOURCE_CARDINALITY_EXCEEDED.title: Resource count exceeds the signed limit
RESOURCE_CARDINALITY_EXCEEDED.next_action: Reduce the number of resources or review the contract limit.

canonical_arguments_changed_before_execu.title: Canonical tool arguments changed since authorization.
canonical_arguments_changed_before_execu.next_action: Inspect the operation binding and approved arguments before another call.

cross_call_data_exfiltration_guard.title: A cross-call data-flow protection refused dispatch.
cross_call_data_exfiltration_guard.next_action: Review data origin, destination and allowed information flow.

dispatch_admission_unavailable.title: Final dispatch authorization could not be verified.
dispatch_admission_unavailable.next_action: Check the admission service and reconcile the operation.

human_review_hold_active.title: An active human-review hold refused dispatch.
human_review_hold_active.next_action: Check the current security review and approved observation.

invalid_tool_arguments_guard.title: Arguments did not pass tool schema validation.
invalid_tool_arguments_guard.next_action: Correct the arguments against the signed tool schema.

inventory_error.title: Authoritative tool inventory could not be verified.
inventory_error.next_action: Restore inventory/readiness and review tool fingerprints.

policy_error.title: A required policy decision could not be established.
policy_error.next_action: Check policy service health; do not interpret this as an OPA rule denial.

request_preparation_error.title: Preparing the MCP call failed safely.
request_preparation_error.next_action: Inspect the request normalization and schema validation codes.

runtime_audit_unavailable.title: Durable Runtime audit was unavailable.
runtime_audit_unavailable.next_action: Restore Runtime audit persistence before retrying.

shared_taint_persistence_failed.title: Required data-flow audit persistence was unavailable.
shared_taint_persistence_failed.next_action: Restore the audit store. Do not bypass this protection.

specialized_adapter_result_blocked.title: The MCP result was withheld by an adapter validation.
specialized_adapter_result_blocked.next_action: Review the adapter's approved contract and recorded result status.

trusted_identity_required.title: Trusted agent identity was not established.
trusted_identity_required.next_action: Review the agent binding and session verification.

unsafe_resource_guard.title: The resource protection refused the request.
unsafe_resource_guard.next_action: Check the resource scope and signed binding without exposing its value.

unsafe_tool_result_blocked.title: The MCP result was withheld by the output security guard.
unsafe_tool_result_blocked.next_action: Inspect sanitized findings. The remote operation may have effects; do not automatically retry.

unsupported_mcp_protocol_profile.title: The protocol profile is unsupported for this server.
unsupported_mcp_protocol_profile.next_action: Compare the negotiated profile with the approved server configuration.

unsupported_policy_decision_for_security.title: The policy returned a legacy decision the active V2 security model does not support.
unsupported_policy_decision_for_security.next_action: Check the deployed runtime policy bundle; V2 emits only ALLOW or BLOCK.
